articles.title: Challenges Facing Biosimilar Formulary Adoption
articles.summary: Managed Healthcare Executive discusses the factors causing biosimilars to lose ground on commercial formularies. This impacts self-funded employers seeking cost savings from lower-priced alternatives to expensive reference biologics and challenges PBM formulary management strategies.
articles.source_line: Source: Managed Healthcare Executive; Mon, 05 Oct 2026

articles.title: Trade Association Seeks Supreme Court Review of Louisiana 340B Law
articles.summary: A trade association has received an extension to petition the Supreme Court to review a Louisiana law impacting the 340B drug pricing program. The outcome of this legal battle could reshape 340B operations and manufacturer restrictions, which indirectly influence overall drug pricing and supply chain costs for self-funded plans.

articles.title: Informa PBM Contracting Summit Highlights Evolving Employer Strategies
articles.summary: The Informa PBM Contracting Summit focuses on emerging trends in PBM contracting, drug pricing strategies, and fiduciary oversight. For self-funded employers, the insights from this summit provide critical guidance on navigating contract renewals, evaluating pricing transparency, and managing specialty drug costs.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Channels; Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:30:00 GMT

articles.title: PBM Disclosure Rules Leave Benefits Brokers Searching for Transparency
articles.summary: New PBM disclosure regulations aimed at increasing pricing transparency are still leaving benefits brokers with significant unanswered questions regarding hidden fees and true net costs. For self-funded employers, broker confusion makes navigating complex PBM contracts and evaluating true value even more challenging.
articles.source_line: Source: Insurance Business; Mon, 05 Oct 2026 19:05:59 GMT

articles.title: Bipartisan Congressional Pressure Mounts on Pharmacy Benefit Managers
articles.summary: Lawmakers from both parties are increasingly targeting pharmacy benefit managers over pricing transparency, rebates, and business practices. This bipartisan scrutiny signals a high likelihood of federal legislative or regulatory changes that will impact how PBMs operate and how self-funded employers manage drug costs.

articles.title: Pharmacy Cost Control Requires Broader Strategy Beyond Standard Discounts
articles.summary: A new advisory warns self-funded employers that relying solely on traditional pharmaceutical discounts is insufficient for managing total pharmacy spend. The report highlights the need for comprehensive cost-management strategies to combat rising employer health plan expenditures. This emphasizes the ongoing shift among self-funded plans toward holistic pharmacy benefit oversight rather than just chasing headline discounts.
articles.source_line: Source: PR Newswire; Mon, 05 Oct 2026 12:08:00 GMT
